svg.title: Мобилизация голеностопа у стены — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Knee-to-wall ankle mobility drill, true side view. Half-kneel facing a vertical wall, rear knee on floor and front foot flat a few centimeters from wall, hands lightly touch wall. START front shin close to vertical, knee separated from wall. FINISH knee travels forward until gently touches wall directly above toes; front heel stays firmly on SAME floor spot. Rear knee stays down, draw wall edge and floor. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
